Stage and investment boundary: "prototype stage, one agent at a time; this repository and its own deploy only; visitor spend capped at $3/day; owner runs on Brian's owner allowance; no new service, engine or repository without Brian's yes." The plan's actor in "## Actor and result" ("a World Builder visitor (and Brian as owner)") matches the outcome's actor. dfd31ee18610886a7dec463ac3754431fc503513.rationale: The plan correctly names the outcome record location (`roadmap/README.md#actor-recurring-job-and-investment-boundary`). The quoted record provides the actor, inspectable result, and investment boundary clearly. However, the requirement mandates that the outcome's actor must be "a person or role with work of their own outside this project...and the recurring job is one that actor does today by hand or with other tools." The quoted evidence states the visitor "describes a situation in plain words, presses Create simulation, and watches the generated people act"—what they do *with* the World Builder—but does not establish what their job is *outside* the World Builder or what baseline job they do by hand or with other tools today. The "baseline" quoted ("Today (2026-10-25) each person picks from the moves the rules already allow") describes a limitation of the *system*, not an external job the visitor performs. Without explicit evidence of the visitor's external work and its current baseline, it cannot be verified that the actor has "work of their own outside this project" or that the outcome avoids self-reference.
